prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit/rebuild the provided costume sprite sheet for the Japanese bullet-hell game Refrain. Input image 1 is the edit target: preserve its clothing design, hairstyle, eye color and accessories. Input image 2 is the authoritative anatomy/linework reference: copy its exact chibi head-to-body ratio, face shape, head size relative to torso, thigh/shin length and shoe size. Do not make a taller fashion illustration.
Deliver one transparent RGBA 3-column x 4-row sprite sheet, portrait 3:4 aspect, ideally 1536x2048. Exactly 11 whole-body sprites and the bottom-right cell empty. Equal cells; no labels, grids, borders, particles, floor, ground shadow, platform, checkerboard or background. Every sprite has the SAME head diameter and body scale; keep crowns/hips at the same local height across all cells, leaving upper space for aiming props. Props/raised hands must NOT cause a smaller person. Leave safe transparent gutters.
EVERY POSE MUST LEVITATE IN MIDAIR, not stand, walk, run or jump off a surface. Both feet are unsupported, toes relaxed/downward, knees softly bent backward, ankles at different heights, cloth and hair gently buoyant. Use the anatomy reference's suspended bent-knee posture for all front/side aiming poses. Even straight-up/down aiming and front/back dodge frames must not have parallel straight weight-bearing legs or level soles. Aerial rotation stays upright about the vertical axis, never somersaulting.
Cell order left to right, top to bottom: 0 idle three-quarter right, 1 aim vertically up, 2 aim diagonally upper-right, 3 aim right, 4 aim diagonally lower-right, 5 aim vertically down, 6 dodge front, 7 dodge right-front three-quarter, 8 dodge right profile, 9 dodge right-back three-quarter, 10 dodge back, 11 empty. In cells 0-5 keep torso upright and head in a consistent near-three-quarter view; aim with arm/prop, not camera perspective. Cells 6-10 are the SAME floating bent-knee pose rotating, arms held close to chest. Match head diameter and limb lengths in every view. Clean professional anime cel shading, crisp readable edges at small gameplay scale, true transparent alpha.

KOHARU costume 'After the Rain': pale yellow hooded short rain cape, ivory sleeves, dark teal pleated dress, dark teal ankle rain boots, short charcoal-teal hair tied in a low small side ponytail, amber eyes, same small white striped hairclip. Closed lilac umbrella used as aiming prop; idle/dodge hold near chest. Do NOT shorten her legs into tiny nubs: match uniform reference's thigh/shin and large-head proportions exactly. All 11 sprites floating with both knees bent backward, boots trailing with toes downward at DIFFERENT heights, never standing with level boot soles. Keep heads same size regardless of umbrella height.
processing: tools/finish_customize_assets.ps1 -CostumesOnly; approved cropping, alpha preservation, resizing and transparent margins only.
